events.title: Guild of Elemental Quests Is Taking Part in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello, everyone!Guild of Elemental Quests is taking part in Steam Next Fest! The demo is now available to download. Come by the guild, take on quests, gather elemental gems, and set off on an adventure. We’d love to hear what you think!In Guild of Elemental Quests, every adventurer is an Elementalist skilled in wielding the power of the elements.
